positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned the org's GitHub-to-Jenkins webhook delivery layer by building the Cloud Webhook Engine from scratch
(Python/FastAPI, SQS, DynamoDB, Redis) with IP allowlisting, auth, and health dashboards.
- Enabled accurate cost attribution across ~100 teams by replacing flat-rate Jenkins billing with a per-user model —
activity sync across 200+ controllers, LDAP validation, and automated cross-charge reports.
- Secured three microservices for project-level access control — JWT enrichment at the gateway, group-based
billing filtering, and a fail-closed default policy (39 new tests, zero regressions).
- Eliminated a manual IT workflow for reprovisioning 200+ Jenkins controllers by building a self-service API with
CJOC integration, audit logging, cooldown enforcement, and a Vue.js frontend.
- Prevented webhook outages from stale IP allowlists by automating release pipelines (Jenkinsfile + ArgoCD Image
Updater) and building a Lambda with defensive validation.
- Reduced false positives in GitHub Actions deprecation tracking by building a semver-aware scanner, weekly
GitHub Pages reports, and the org-wide migration runbook.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed end to end Property 360 functionality using Spring Boot and Angular frameworks
- Leveraged AWS scripting to maintain compliance with cloud governance requirements
- Utilized UrbanCode Deploy and SonarQube to solve deployment issues and code smells
- Filled JUnit gaps to cover at least 70% of new and existing code
- Utilized Git, Jenkins, and the AWS console to commit, push, and monitor newly developed code

positions.description: Researcher at Riggs Lab. Focusing on how eye tracking data can improve UI displays for UAV operators.

positions.title: College Technical Intern
positions.description: Utilized Java frameworks to develop, test, and debug a government contracted, top secret level project.

positions.title: 2020 Student Challenge Winner
